description: A planner hands three approaches to a forecasting task to three workers, each in its own git worktree; they work at the same time, and the planner chooses the best.
prepare: (cd "$DEMO/workspace" && git init -q -b main && git add -A && git -c user.name=planner -c user.email=planner@complier.invalid commit -qm 'The task and its data')

windows.title: planner
windows.run: complier agent --harness {harness} --machine fan-out --role planner 'You are the planner: follow PLANNER.md.'

windows.title: worker1
windows.run: complier agent --harness {harness} --machine fan-out --role worker1 'You are worker1: follow WORKER.md.'

windows.title: worker2
windows.run: complier agent --harness {harness} --machine fan-out --role worker2 'You are worker2: follow WORKER.md.'

windows.title: worker3
windows.run: complier agent --harness {harness} --machine fan-out --role worker3 'You are worker3: follow WORKER.md.'

setup.title: Copy the demo, and make its workspace a git repository
setup.text: cp -R ~/.complier/examples/fan-out ~/fan-out && cd ~/fan-out/workspace && git init -q -b main && git add -A && git commit -qm 'The task and its data'

setup.title: Start the planner (in ~/fan-out/workspace)
setup.text: complier agent --harness {harness} --machine fan-out --role planner 'You are the planner: follow PLANNER.md.'

setup.title: Start each worker (in ~/fan-out/workspace; worker1, worker2, worker3)
setup.text: complier agent --harness {harness} --machine fan-out --role worker1 'You are worker1: follow WORKER.md.'
